messages:
Asha (CEO): Thanks for joining today. If you have follow-ups about mission, market focus, or competitor positioning drop them here.
Ravi (Field Eng): Quick from a demo: customers ask for one simple line to summarize when to pick Private vs Dedicated vs Hosted.
Maya (Head of Strategy): TL;DR: Hosted = iterate fast; Dedicated = committed throughput + isolation; Private = full network/data control for regulated environments.
Priya (VP Product): Add nuance: Dedicated is best when you need predictable unit cost at scale; Private when policy/compliance mandates customer-managed networking.
Ravi (Field Eng): Nice. Also customers ask: how do we actually guarantee stability vs public endpoints? any replicable talking points?
Marco (CTO): Emphasize: unified runtime with canary rollouts, per-route observability (p50/p95 + token-cost), and automated fallbacks to compatible model variants. Those make SLA behavior practical.
Maya (Head of Strategy): For external comms avoid named competitors. Focus on outcomes: predictable economics, deployment flexibility, rollout safety.
Priya (VP Product): We'll produce a one-page FAQ for sales + demos and post the link here.
ops-bot: Slides and recording uploaded: https://redwood.example.com/all-hands/2234567890 :white_check_mark:
Asha (CEO): Perfect. Maya will share the FAQ by Friday. If anyone has critical bullets add them now.
